notes.title: Our Next Game Announcement
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled today, to unveil the first teaser trailer for ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL, and you can watch it right here on STEAM:



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591790/ANIMAL_USE_PROTOCOL/




[previewyoutube=aws6p_Z_2uc;full][/previewyoutube]



Unlike our past games, AUP will be first-person and lean towards survival horror. 

[b]You can still expect a deep, gut-wrenching narrative that will test our characters' bonds to their limits.
[/b]

Play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee, leading the desperate escape of lab animals from a nightmarish research facility, Anchorage Station.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/dbd5e83859782b08cb670886151fca80aaf5b43d.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/8a98346e0a60eba099714da22e21d239c9890307.gif[/img]


Penn is joined by Trip, a scrappy, smart-ass rat - with your help, they’ll survive long enough to save their fellow lab animals.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/36ae17f95c573359bfd352d37d45b6bd687fdb44.gif[/img]


Using a gravity-manipulation, physics-based tool, you’ll handle heavy and hazardous materials both offensively and creatively in problem-solving.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/01103ec14791a6807abaed44c860158d0ad24c45.gif[/img]


[b]You need to be quiet as a mouse...
...but bold as a rat![/b]


The STEAM page is live, and you can add ANIMAL USE PROTOCOL to your Wishlist right now.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591790/ANIMAL_USE_PROTOCOL/

We’re excited to share more of what we’re working on, so be sure to Wishlist and follow our social media on X: [url=https://twitter.com/StasisGame]@StasisGame[/url] or join our mailing list at [url=https://www.animaluseprotocol.com]https://www.animaluseprotocol.com[/url]

notes.title: NOW ON MAC OSX!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/59327ab4a6f02b7774011db2e64e2e056bc91756.png[/img]

Hey Mac Gamers!

[b]Stasis: Bone Totem is finally here for Mac users.
[/b]

Bone Totem dives into an eerie, sci-fi world where you follow Mac and Charlie, a couple of deep-sea scavengers who stumble on something way more sinister than they bargained for. Imagine a deserted underwater structure filled with secrets, corporate espionage and creepy things, plus plenty of puzzles to keep you on your toes. Throw in a [b]toy bear [/b]and you have the recipe for a great game.

A perfect horror vibe for a late-night Mac Halloween gaming session.

Enjoy!

PS

A quick note, the first time you load Bone Totem, the game may take a minute or two to load and uncompressed all the graphics so make a cup of tea or pour a stiff drink and then check it out!

PPS

A special thanks to the Steam Mac community who tested this with us.

notes.title: STASIS: BONE TOTEM WINS BIG
notes.notes:
The Aggie Awards for 2023 have just been announced, and STASIS: BONE TOTEM won in four categories and was the runner up in five more!

We notably won Best Non-Traditional Adventure and Best Adventure of 2023!

Moses also poked his cute nose out and won Best Character of 2023.

The Aggies are a big deal in the adventure game community, with the largest and oldest adventure game community around it, with a staff of veteran gamers and developers.

You can read about the awards here:

https://adventuregamers.com/articles/view/the-aggie-awards-the-best-adventure-games-of-2023

notes.title: LAUNCH DATE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I am beyond excited to share the news that STASIS: BONE TOTEM, the latest installment in the STASIS anthology, will be released on May 31st, 2023!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/

WATCH THE ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER HERE:

[previewyoutube=he1Z0mnDq_0;full][/previewyoutube]

As you know, BONE TOTEM is the ambitious follow-up to the award-winning adventure game STASIS that you guys have brought to life.

What makes BONE TOTEM so unique is its underwater setting, where players will follow the story of Mac and Charlie - a couple who scour the ocean for valuable salvage. However, when they stumble upon an abandoned oil rig in the Pacific Ocean, they discover a secret that Cayne Corporation will do anything to keep hidden. (You know the drill!)

Mark Morgan joined us again to compose the score, and we had a Hollywood screenwriter (J. Barton Mitchell) pen the screenplay. We also involved a professional studio, Night Rocket Productions, to manage the in-person acting and audio recording. All of the actors are seasoned TV and Film professionals. Don't worry - Ryan and Glen Cooper also joined us again with a superb performance. You're gonna love it!

BONE TOTEM will be available on PC, including Steam/Steam Deck.

With support for English, German, French, Russian, Polish, Spanish, Turkish, and Italian languages on launch.

The thrilling adventure starts on May 31st!

So wishlist (if you haven't):

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/

I can't wait for you to join Mac, Charlie, and their trusty Super-Toy, Moses.

notes.title: STASIS 2 - BONE TOTEM - AUGUST UPDATE
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/


I'm excited to update you on the progress of STASIS 2 - BONE TOTEM!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/0ebb0ec575691e84af2e1779614ea34d424cffa8.png[/img]

[b]GRAPHICS[/b]

Once we've decided on how the puzzle works, it can take several days to design and illustrate the associated scenes. A puzzle may span several large screens, so all of the rooms have to be planned and detailed concurrently to ensure that the puzzles and interactions will work. We also have to take into account that our puzzle solutions will often involve multiple characters in different areas. STASIS 2 features character switching like the classic adventure game, Day of the Tentacle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/0ba555c3a0c0f1970d1a78f289a72a660d2f1a53.png[/img]

Working with our 3D technician, Mark, who is a 40-year veteran architectural expert, made all the difference in BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION. Structures actually worked as they would in real life (that is until Chris made them look post-apocalyptic). His work on the new STASIS game is fantastic and brings a real-world ‘this could exist?’ edge to the imagery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/569d6d04f4dab65962266622c48190ed9a0dd5fc.gif[/img]

Here are some elements for a yet-to-be-revealed part of the story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/c75788fcd649815d555d8c1bdcf0d63d1f60178e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/10615a640ec576719b0f3d44dad2845525e57843.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/5f0f082dad16753a001fa69938479d43d54e022a.jpg[/img]
Chris is working on the final chapter of Mac and Charlie and so the gameplay is heating up! We have connected most of the game environments together which means you can traverse from one side of the world to the other. Specific puzzle implementation (ie. puzzle code!) will only happen once all screens are completed.

We are trying to find a balance between the familiar world of STASIS and something new and interesting as you can see in these screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/aeae27eff8f9968e20d598de94686428e2a4d55c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/62caedb338cbb26b06df999e8fedeba565bac551.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/75b116da567d7166c4148779bc57fb1188ab0e98.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39093236/b6aa6abd1aa4a25095535f31523432e789c0942e.jpg[/img]


[b]GAMEPAD[/b]

Nic has been hard at work implementing native gamepad control - a first for our games - which has not been an easy task, as the scope of reference for gamepad controlled point-and-click adventures is little to none. We considered the ‘virtual cursor’ method that would be easiest in so far as you have a cursor that the player can move with the gamepad. However, this seems like we're losing a great opportunity to explore a different player interface mechanic. Our games have always been a disadvantage as compared to their 3D first-person counterparts, as we need to rely on the players' other senses to form for immersion. The mouse control forms a disconnect whereas the gamepad is a direct control input of the character which could be interesting to explore. We also don't want to isolate our mouse-only players so it is a fine line to balance.

Bearing this in mind, we also have our limitations as essentially a two-man studio. We did it! You can now hot-swap the gamepad and mouse, and STASIS will play as per normal. The systems are also similar so it means less duplicated code to do the same tasks. This may make future console releases quicker and more seamless to our own internal development QA.

[b]MUSIC[/b]

As you know, we pride ourselves on only working with the best. We have a surprise for you, but it shall only be revealed later. It's epic!

[b]WRITING[/b]

Daniel has been hacking away at the text descriptions in the world. Whereas we dedicated a month to write the descriptions in the previous STASIS game, Daniel has now spent the better part of the year writing and crafting each description. He is an immensely talented professional RPG writer and I am sure you will love his prose! 

[b]WISHLIST[/b]

Please wishlist the game if you have not already. This is important for the Steam metrics when we launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/



[b]SOCIALS[/b]

Be sure to follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/StasisGame and we keep our Blog updated with minor news here: https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/

Oh, and join our Discord - we love to chat!

https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/studio/discord

Take care,

[i][b]Chris & Nic[/b][/i]
